facts.fact: The article 'Giganotosaurus' was promoted to Featured Article status on November 19, 2016.
The nomination for 'Giganotosaurus' was made by the user FunkMonk on September 30, 2016.
Only one Founder needs to accept a nomination for it to be voted on at the voting stage in the Dinosaur Wiki Featured Article nominations.
Sarcosuchus won the Featured Article nomination by 2 votes to 1 in October.

result.summary: The article 'Giganotosaurus' was nominated for Featured Article status by FunkMonk and was promoted on November 19, 2016. In the Dinosaur Wiki, nominations require acceptance from only one Founder to proceed to voting, as demonstrated by the October win of Sarcosuchus.
